crosswalks.historical_boundary: Begho archaeological area around modern Hani; no closed medieval rural boundary was supplied. Posnansky's excavation units were distributed within a 6 km radius, while Allan notes that Begho likely denotes a region/area rather than a discrete market locus.
crosswalks.resolution_method: The explicit EU5 begho location is retained as a named-site diagnostic only. Its 7,728.68 km2 footprint is not substituted for the undefined Begho archaeological area and the 6 km excavation radius is not promoted to a historical boundary.
blocking_reasons: no closed historical rural or town polygon
historical population peak is 1400s-1700s rather than a 1337 observation
trade-entrepot and heterogeneous urban quarters make local-food share unresolved
crosswalks.notes: This is an explicit rejection, not a missing row: 0% aggregate boundary coverage is recorded, and the model must not learn from the 5,000-10,000 town estimate. A future promotion would require a dated, mapped rural catchment and independent local-food/pressure evidence.
